caption: POV: I made a blog focused on plant-based recipes and now I help thousands of families with my meals ❤️ When my husband and I got married 17 years ago, we quickly realized that we were raised on two very different styles of eating habits. My background focused on health and nutrition and his on quick and easy meals. To bridge the gap between the foods he loved and the healthy ingredients I craved, I started creating healthier versions of his favorite meals. Realizing we couldn’t be the only couple to go through a situation like this, led me to create a blog, which then turned into a full time business, where I share recipes, tips, and my experience to help other families facing similar challenges! Want to see why thousands of people are choosing The Picky Eater to make healthy, nutritious, and tasty meals for their families?
